page.overview:
Who is Cow Farmer?

The Cow Farmer seems to be a humanoid Farmer with green skin and a beard. As his name suggests, he is wearing Farmer attire, with a hat and Farmer clothes. He is seen wielding a gun with which he used to threaten the wizards.

He is very impatient and protective, taking no time to question let alone help the wizards, immediately concluding that they must be delt with by threatening to shoot them.
